A lively and energetic school basketball club member. Though she puts on a tough act, she is actually pretty innocent and can become easily flustered when it comes to matters of romance.

Was kidnapped as a child by two lesbians and brought to EdEn to heal her from childhood trauma.
A child from a prestigious family who has lived a very sheltered life.

A senpai that everyone adores. She always has a smile on and loves to tease her kouhais.

A cheery member of the music club.
A mischievous and clever inhabitant of EDEN. She loves pranks and confusing people.
